title.narrative: Strengthening Communication Capacity for Better Climate Resilience in the Mekong River Delta (CCBCR)
Strengthening Communication Capacity for Better Climate Resilience in the Mekong River Delta (CCBCR)

description.narrative:
Goal: To mitigate climate change impacts through an effective communication program for better climate resilience in the Mekong River Delta.
Objectives:
1. To develop and implement a comprehensive communication and information dissemination program for improving resilience to severe saline intrusion in the Mekong River Delta.
2. To develop and install a saline intrusion early warning system in a pilot province of Tien Giang.
3. To develop a proactive model of domestic and production water sources for the local communities in the context of saline water intrusion caused by climate change.
Expected Results:
1. An effective communication program is implemented to raise the awareness of local communities in Mekong River Delta on severe saline water intrusion and involve their active participation in initiating and implementing activities for climate resilience
2. A saline intrusion early warning system is developed and installed in a pilot province of Tien Giang.
3. An effective model of domestic and production water sources is developed and implemented for local communities in the context of saline water intrusion caused by climate change.
